thread:
alex: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

alex: Did: landed kernel patch to reduce memory for kv cache, ran one pass of throughput bench on r5.4xlarge, saw ~8% p50 improvement but p95 unchanged.

alex: Blockers: still seeing >1% token-drop on long chat sessions; suspect kv eviction logic when prefix mismatch. Also need review on PR #3214 (kernel/kv-evict) — pinging @mira

alex: Today: iterate on eviction heuristics, add per-tenant cache caps, and run longer 2hr perf job.

mira: saw the PR, skimming now. Noticed missing unit test for eviction boundary. I'll add a quick one and re-run CI.

jordan: Did: microbatch scheduler fix merged, added helpful logs for batch size distribution. Observed more stable latency under burst.

jordan: Blocker: scheduler sometimes reduces batch size to 1 with sudden small payloads, need better batching delay policy. Trying a 8ms hold window.

sam: FYI I pushed a tiny kv-metrics exporter change: exports per-tenant hit-rate. Dashboard added at /dash/kv-hitrate. Can someone check numbers from the long run?

ciara: ran 2hr perf overnight on the new kernel + 8ms hold; results: tokens/sec +6%, tail latency p99 down 12%. Uploading CSV: https://internal/s3/bench/1799123456.csv

alex: awesome, thanks @ciara — can you confirm whether p95 improved? Also any memory regression?

ciara: p95 improved ~6%. Memory steady, small bump in RSS (~30MB) under high concurrency but within margin.

mira: added test + minor comments on PR. @alex re: token-drop, can you share a replay trace? If it's eviction boundary we should add a guard in kernel to prefer kv-keep if recent reuse.

alex: uploading trace gist: https://internal/gists/trace-1799123456

jordan: I'll try the 8ms hold in canary; if green, we can include in next rollout. Also assigning CR to @sam for metrics sanity-check.

sam: on it. Quick note: exporter labels might multiplex tenant+model, so watch cardinality.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for runtime-canary-1789 at 2026-03-16T08:20:00Z :rocket:

alex: ping @mira @jordan — if no objections I'll schedule longer 4hr perf tomorrow morning and block the cluster to avoid noise.

mira: +1

jordan: +1

alex: cool, i'll schedule and drop notes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
